inlines.v: WINDLAS, WINDLASS noun [wind and lace.] 1. A machine for raising great weights, consisting of a cylinder or roller of timber, moving on its axis and turned by levers, with a rope or chain attached to the weight. 2. A handle by which any thing is turned. [Not in use.]
